title: Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection
mechanism: Robust normalisation, DSU feature-statistic perturbation, progressive random convolution, small-defect loss, score calibration, and a SWAD variant with metric-aligned checkpoint selection for unseen production scenarios.
adaptation: Closest domain found (boards with surface contaminants, like scuffs). Take DSU in encoder layer1-2 and checkpoint selection on val relF1@2 rather than loss; drop detection-only parts (NWD, VFL).
min_experiment: PF + DSU vs PF, 3 seeds; kill at < +0.03 E1 crack relF1@2.
evidence: R: Track 1 score 0.564, screening 0.696 on hidden test, single RTX 4090; no ablation in abstract.
